title: Get Local: a town you choose opens within 10 miles; its area is its own choice
why: decisions/0053 ("Town names on a place page open Get Local": a town opens centred on it, nearest first, within 10 miles by default, the distance changeable), applied to the place pop-up by P9 (Jason, 2026-11-13: "choosing one of our towns in Get Local sets the town (Within 10 mi), and its area stays a separate choice"); the launch plan's C.4, which blocks the path "Set my place and distance" (decisions/0181 §1 gate 1). The pop-up already set the town as a point (place.php), but Get Local started every point at any distance, so a chosen town showed "within any distance"; now a town picked, or opened by ?town=, starts within 10 mi, and a ?radius= in the address still wins. Near me, a ZIP and a map area keep the nearest first with no cap (decisions/0060). In the pop-up, the area that search reads for a town ("Show Low, AZ · Town in …") was listed with the town's own name; it's now listed once, by the area's name, as "Town area". The FAQ's "When I choose a town, why can I set how far to look, and what is its 'Town area'?" already says this; the page now matches it. No data, no outside calls, no cost.

changes.what: Get Local: choose a town in the place pop-up: "within 10 mi of <town>", the distance changeable in the sentence
The place pop-up: the town first, its area once by its own name as "Town area"
